maps.name: Frozen Lake Retreat (Alpine Snow Village)
maps.scope: 24 x 20 m winter combat environment; 54.2k triangles

maps.name: Desert Canyons and Oases - Canyon Narrows Assembly
maps.scope: assembled canyon section, not the entire 88-model pack

characters.name: Three.js Soldier
characters.scope: Rigged humanoid with Idle, Walk, Run and T-Pose animation clips

notes: All three maps are downloaded and GLB-validated locally before the game starts, then preloaded sequentially in the background.
Enemy bots use independent skeleton clones of the rigged animated soldier GLB; procedural characters are only a fallback if the model fails to load.
Imported GLB scenes provide visual geometry only; gameplay collision/navmesh remains project-owned.
Fonts use local system fallbacks; no Google Fonts request is made.
